csv_project_name: Design Services for Facility Repairs - Sheriff's Office
csv_scope_of_work: Brazoria County is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from firms who can adequately demonstrate they have the resources, experience, and qualifications to perform professional engineering, design, and construction administration services for a federally funded disaster recovery project associated with facility repairs at multiple Brazoria County Sheriff s Office (BCSO) facilities impacted by Hurricane Beryl. From this RFSQ, the County will select a firm who will provide engineering design services, construction administration services, and project coordination necessary to support federal funding eligibility, compliance, and successful project delivery.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
